channel.title: Vignan AI writing
channel.description: Six pieces about studying, written by the student who built Vignan Vidyanikethan AI.

item.title: How to check an AI answer before you trust it
item.description: Five minutes and one book page. If an answer survives that, it is worth more than a paragraph nobody can check.

item.title: How to revise a chapter you have already forgotten
item.description: Reading it again feels like revision and usually is not. Here is the version that hurts a little and stays.

item.title: How to study with only a phone
item.description: No laptop, one small screen and a connection that comes and goes is the normal case, not a disadvantage to apologise for.

item.title: Why writing your own questions beats re-reading
item.description: The person who writes the question has to know what the answer depends on. That is the part you are missing.

item.title: A fixed routine for physics numericals
item.description: Most marks are lost in the first line, not the last. Seven lines, every problem, no exceptions.

item.title: How to explain a school project in sixty seconds
item.description: A judge decides whether to keep listening in about a minute. Five sentences, in a fixed order, survive that minute.
